title: Retrieve and validate
summary: Agree the request, retrieve within its scope and check the returned information before using it.

sections.label: Validation principle
sections.text: OWASP recommends validating accepted structure and business rules. Access checks remain separate.

sections.label: Apply it to your workflow
items: Name the approved interface and required inputs.
Define expected results, permitted scope and resource limits.
Check normal, empty, invalid and unavailable cases.
Record observed results separately from expectations.
If later steps write data, define their authorization and confirmation separately.

sections.label: What changes
sections.text: Review Add retrieval checks to select this practice. WORKFLOW.md and SOURCES.md will record the guidance and its source. Existing steps, roles, tools, facts and evidence stay as recorded.

sections.label: What still needs work
sections.text: Your team supplies the real interface, credentials, commands, fixtures and acceptance decisions. The downloaded instructions do not enforce these checks.

confidence: Documented facts have scoped sources. Suitability for a particular project remains unverified.

catalog.applicability: Use when designing how existing information is retrieved and checked.
catalog.limits: This is design guidance. It does not connect to a service or prove that a result is correct.

claims.text: Validation should check structure and business rules separately from authorization.
